sloka: गतिर् एवाक् पतिर् नार्या द्वितीया गतिर् आत्मजः ।तृतीया ज्ञातयो राजमः चतुर्थी न इह विद्यते ॥२-६१-२४॥
transliteration: gatir evāk patir nāryā dvitīyā gatir ātmajaḥ ।tṛtīyā jñātayo rājamaḥ caturthī na iha vidyate ॥2-61-24॥

translations.english: Valiant and mightyarmed Rama, with his golden shafts can annihilate all living beings and oceans like at the time of deluge everything is consumed in fire.
